turns.speaker: PROVIDER
turns.text: Hi Mr. Tan, how are you feeling now after the surgery?

turns.speaker: PATIENT
turns.text: I’m okay, got some pain here, but manageable.

turns.speaker: PROVIDER
turns.text: Can you give me a pain score out of 10?

turns.speaker: PROVIDER
turns.text: Any nausea or feeling like you might vomit?

turns.speaker: PATIENT
turns.text: A bit queasy, but didn’t throw up.

turns.speaker: PROVIDER
turns.text: Any sore throat, cough, or breathing difficulties?

turns.speaker: PATIENT
turns.text: Slight sore throat, but breathing’s fine.

turns.speaker: PROVIDER
turns.text: Do you remember anything from the operation?

turns.speaker: PROVIDER
turns.text: Any issues with your blood pressure, blood sugar, or reflux since the surgery?

turns.speaker: PATIENT
turns.text: No dizziness or anything, but sometimes I get heartburn at night.
